title: NVIDIA Gemma-4-31B-IT NVFP4 Quantized Model
summary: An official 4-bit floating point (NVFP4) quantized version of Google’s Gemma-4-31B-IT LLM, optimized by NVIDIA for the Blackwell architecture. It maintains nearly full accuracy while enabling high-efficiency 256K context processing on consumer hardware.
research_notes: Native support requires NVIDIA Blackwell (RTX 5000 series) Tensor Cores for fine-grained block scaling; older architectures like Hopper require software emulation via vLLM.

evolution.summary: This model marks the transition to native NVFP4 hardware acceleration on Blackwell GPUs, allowing local execution of GPT-4 class reasoning. It supports speculative decoding via dedicated drafter models for 4x throughput improvements.
